knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A warning line gives notice of the edge. Anyone between the line and the edge needs an arrest system.
A loose cover can move under a person. It is secured and marked, and the opening is barricaded while the cover is handled.
The control still has to be complete and sound. The principle is not replaced by a figure.

practicalCriteria: Measures or checks a supplied guardrail for top rail height, mid-rail, toe board and fixing against the approved standard
Covers, secures and marks a supplied opening, and shows the cover does not move under foot pressure
Rejects a warning line used as the only edge control, and states the control that replaces it
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Edge and opening check record for a supplied site
Assessor observation of the rail and cover checks
stopWorkCriteria: A guardrail that is missing, loose or below height is not used
An uncovered opening near work stops the work until it is covered or guarded
